ValidationRule.description: Standard deals entering RFP need an estimated bid release date for Proposal Ops. Renewals are exempt (2026-10-05): their path walks through RFP on the way to Contract and the rule was producing placeholder dates.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISBLANK( Est_Bid_Release_Date__c ) && ISPICKVAL( StageName , "RFP" ) && ISCHANGED( StageName ) && RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Renewal"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in Estimated Bid Release Date before changing Stage to RFP
